en:
Welcome! You've hopelessly arrived once
again!

Hm? Did you wanna come here again cuz
of how wonderful it is?

Isn't it wonderful? I put so much effort into
building this place, it should be a monument.

Actually, we're the ones who used the
Exisals to build this courtroom...
But Father just took all the credit!

BUT-I-AM-HAPPY...TO-BE-USED-AS-A-
SLAVE...BY-FATHER.

...You idiots are really committin' to this
henchmen bit.

You guys are just so cute that I can't
help working you to the bone.

You put a lot of elaborate detail into this
courtroom. Almost like it's for show.

For show, huh? That's an interesting way
to put it.

Is this just for show? Are you showing this
to the people outside and—

Puhuhu. Those people aren't with us, so
you don't need to worry about them.

Get it? They're not with us. As in, they're
no longer with us, y'know what I mean?

In other words...you 13 are the only ones
left in the world.

Now, show me just how you intend to bargain
for your lives!
Ah-hahahahaha!
<CLT=cltMIND>Then...the class trial began.
<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma Hoshi, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Tennis Pro<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>After falling from his former glory,
he told us he had no reason to live...

<CLT=cltMIND>But even so...he said he wanted to fight
beside us. To get out of here with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>For that, he was trying to find
a reason to live.

<CLT=cltMIND>He might have been a little stern...
but he wasn't a cold man at all.
<CLT=cltMIND>And the person who killed him...
<CLT=cltMIND>...is here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to believe that's a lie.
I don't want to believe it at all.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...

<CLT=cltMIND>If this is where I find the truth...
I won't avert my eyes anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is...the wish she entrusted to me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I *will* find the truth.
To get out of here, with everyone. Alive.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to survive.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't die here.
In order to keep my promise to <CLT=cltSTRONG>her<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight for my life in this
trial of truth and lies!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
